origin: the 2026-08-14 principle, restated by the 2026-10-02 plan: not 'everything is a plugin' but a trusted microkernel plus replaceable capability providers plus controlled external adapters
trusted_microkernel_never_plugin: the binding rules between Learning / AI assets and Evidence
invariant: A plugin must never write the canonical database. It receives a bounded request and returns a result the Core validates and commits.

already_present: capability routes are declared by the launch rather than assumed from a checkout layout
the Core registers exactly what is declared (Executor::open_routes)
a worker identity allow-list refuses an unexpected worker before it serves anything
the receipt carries the engine and engine_version, so a result names what produced it
missing_for_R7_G1: a capability resolver exposed over HTTP
